Memora v2.1.0 - Personal AI Knowledge Base

- Initial public release as a self-hosted AI-powered knowledge base.
- Features semantic search, LLM-driven Q&A, and hybrid retrieval combining vector and sparse search.
- Supports document upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD), web scraping, and robust knowledge graph visualization with interactive Obsidian-style layout.
- Provides real-time multi-turn chat, source-attributed answers, and web API integration.
- Designed for privacy with local/offline deployment and simple environment configuration.
